{{Top|leg}}
The '''Fortress-7 electronic deadbolt system''' was a low-cost security package that was nonetheless efficient at keeping [[Thief/Legends|thieves]] and trespassers out of restricted areas. However, with the proper tools and knowhow, they were not impossible to bypass.
